decisionsTitle: A changed confirmation window moves the holds it gave, and the last call follows its deadline (amending §104, §160, §407)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-05**, on «Înscrieri» filtered «Așteaptă semnarea declarației», every row reading «Poate semna până sâm., 21 nov. 2026, la 10:00» (the start): «Trebuie să schimbăm până când poate semna cineva declarația, trebuie să fie cu max 5 zile înainte de înscriere, și să putem da reminder». He then set the race's «Fereastra de confirmare» to 15 / 5 — asked from 6 November, owed by 16 November at 10:00 for the 21 November start — and asked «Dacă pun așa e ok?».

**Two gaps, and why they existed.** The window (§104, §407) is two numbers on the event, read by `confirmationWindow`; a hold taken before the window opens is given the window's instant once, when the address is confirmed (`computeDeclarationHoldExpiry`), and stored on the row (`hold_expires_at`) — §377's rule that a deadline already given is never rewritten by a later setting. So (1) a save that changed the window recomputed nothing: every place given while the deadline was 0 still held the start, while the editor, the emails and the job's ask read the new deadline. And (2) the last call to sign (§160) was timed by the reminder's lead before the START: with a deadline five days out and a reminder three days out, it would leave two days after every window hold had lapsed — to nobody it could help.

**Decision 1 — a save of the event moves the holds its window gave.** In the save's own transaction, under `lockEventForCapacity`, after the event row is written (`registrations/window-holds.ts#moveWindowHolds`, the pure rules in `registrations/domain/window-holds.ts`), on a scheduled event with registration here. Which holds: a `PENDING_DECLARATION` hold that ends a whole number of days before the start as it stood before the save (0 to 60 — `isWindowGivenInstant`): the old window's instant, and any older window's (the start a deadline of 0 gave, the owner's case: his 15 / 5 is already saved and his places still hold the start). The club's minutes (§377) are counted from a click, an outage's move (§657) by the time the door was shut; neither lands on a whole day before the start, and a hold at the registration close (where the club's minutes are capped) is left unless it is the old instant itself — at the close as saved and at the close as it stood before the save, so a save that moves the close does not take the holds capped at the old one (a close a whole number of days before the start) for a window's and lock their places away from the waiting list until the start. Where to: the new window's instant — `computeDeclarationHoldExpiry` as if confirmed before the opening, min(deadline, start); with the window switched off, the start (§160's lenient rule stands) — never earlier than now plus the club's `holdMinutes` (a save at the last minute expires nobody on the spot) and never after the start. Once the new deadline is behind that floor, only the old instant's holds move, and only when the window changed: an unchanged window never shortens a kept hold. A moved start carries the holds given against the old one. A series save moves each date's holds to that date's own deadline.

With them, in lockstep (§657's `moveTokenWith` discipline): a live declaration link — unused, not replaced — whose `expires_at` ended with the hold follows it; since §160 the renderer mints that link until the start, so it follows only a moved start. One audit row per moved registration (`registration.hold_moved_by_window`: who saved, from, to) and one on the event (`event.holds_moved_by_window`: how many — the test ones apart — to when, how many emails). A test registration moves like a real one (§30: `kind` in no condition). When the save happens inside an open window, each moved row is sent `COMPLETE_DECLARATION` once more — its words already state the deadline — through the outbox with one drain after the commit, keyed `registration:<id>:deadline-moved:<new instant>` (a retried or repeated save sends nothing twice), unless its own declaration email is still waiting to leave (it renders the stored deadline when it does). A declaration email that left within the hour (§606's `RECENT_DECLARATION_EMAIL_MS`) holds the move's back only when the deadline moved later — the recent email's earlier deadline is still safe to act on; when it moved earlier the move's email goes whatever left within the hour, unless that recent email already carried the new instant in its key, because the person would otherwise wait for a deadline that no longer holds and learn the real one only from the last call, or never when `lastCallHours` is 0 (`recentEmailHoldsBack`). The move's email takes the key of whatever the job would send next for the same deadline, so the person gets one email, not two identical ones minutes apart (`movedEmailKey`): when the new deadline's last call (Decision 2) is already due, or due within that hour — the usual case for a deadline moved in its last two days — it is that last call, under `registration:<id>:sign-reminder:<deadline>`; otherwise, when the window is open and its own ask (§104) is owed for the moved hold and was never queued — a save that widened the window so that it is open now, 7 / 2 turned 15 / 5 ten days out — it is that ask, under `registration:<id>:confirm-participation`, and `queueParticipationConfirmations` queues nothing after it. Before the window opens nothing is sent: the window's own ask (§104) says the new deadline on its day. A second identical save moves nothing.

**No overbooking (AGENTS.md §10.6).** The move writes `hold_expires_at` alone, compare-and-set, under the lock every allocation takes; it seats nobody, releases nobody and adds no place. A moved hold still counts its place by its status, and lapses only when somebody waits for it, by `expireStaleHolds`, untouched (§160). Waiting-list offers are not declaration holds and do not move — an offer is a promise to the queue.

**What the organizer reads.** Under the two numbers, the «Fereastra de confirmare» card says what the next save does, from the move's own rules on the stored window: «Salvarea mută 3 locuri rezervate la termenul ferestrei, lun., 16 nov. 2026, 10:00; dacă schimbi numerele, la termenul nou.», or, when they already hold it, «3 locuri rezervate țin până lun., 16 nov. 2026, la 10:00. Dacă schimbi numerele, salvarea le mută la termenul nou.» Once that deadline is behind and nothing would move, the card says nothing: a sentence holding places until a date gone by would be wrong. After the save, the banner: «Salvarea a mutat 3 locuri rezervate la termenul nou, …» and, inside an open window, that each was emailed again. Real registrations only in both counts.

**Decision 2 — the last call follows the window's deadline.** A new «Termene» setting, `lastCallHours` («Ultima chemare la semnat pleacă înaintea termenului ferestrei cu (ore)», 0–168, default 48, 0 = none before the deadline). On an event whose window is due before the start, a row whose hold ends at that deadline gets its last call `lastCallHours` before it, once per deadline instant (`registration:<id>:sign-reminder:<deadline>`), so a deadline a save moved earns one more; none at or before the window's opening, where the window's own ask is the call; nothing after the deadline. Every other row — no window, a deadline at the start, the club's minutes inside the window — keeps §160's rule: the reminder's lead before the start, `registration:<id>:sign-reminder`. One formula (`declarationLastCallDueAt`, `windowLastCallAt`, `lastCallKey`) for the job, the forecast on «Emailuri» (§383) and the job's next wake (§334); the «Emailuri» description of `COMPLETE_DECLARATION` says it in the club's number.

**For the owner's question.** Yes: 15 / 5 asks from 6 November and owes the signature by 16 November at 10:00. After this release, one more save of the race moves the places already reserved (they hold the start today) to 16 November, and the last call goes on 14 November at 10:00.

*Rejected:* a new reminder button — «Retrimite declarația tuturor care nu au semnat» on the event's page (§606) and «Mesaje» → «Cei care nu au semnat» (§364) already exist; moving waiting-list offers (a promise to the queue, made for a day); a backfill migration (the save moves, nothing else — a migration cannot know which window a club meant); moving holds on a cancelled event (its queue is left as it was cancelled, §331 — a save that puts it back on aligns them); a live recount in the browser as the numbers are typed (a client island for a sentence the banner says exactly after the save); keeping the start's last call as well for a window hold (two calls, the second after the place could already be gone).
changelogLine: - **A changed confirmation window moves the places it reserved, and the last call to sign comes before its deadline** — saving «Fereastra de confirmare» moves every place the window held (a deadline of 0's start included) to the new deadline in the same save, never earlier than the club's hold minutes from now, with the card saying how many before and the banner after, and an email to each inside an open window; the last call to sign goes «Termene» «Ultima chemare» hours (48) before the window's deadline, not before the start. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given an event with `PENDING_DECLARATION` holds that end a whole number of days before its start (a hold its participation window gave, under the window stored or an older one), when a save of the event's row changes the window, the start, or finds those holds at another instant than the window's, then in the save's transaction and under the event lock each such hold moves to `min(deadline, start)` of the window as saved (the start with no window), never earlier than now plus the club's hold minutes and never after the start; once that instant is behind the floor only the old window's holds move, and only when the window changed; holds of the club's minutes, a hold at the registration close as saved or as it stood before the save (unless it is the old window's instant), waiting-list offers and a cancelled event's holds stay; a test registration moves like a real one; each live declaration link that ended with its hold follows it; one `registration.hold_moved_by_window` audit row per registration and one `event.holds_moved_by_window` on the event are written; inside an open window each moved registration is queued `COMPLETE_DECLARATION` once per new instant (`registration:<id>:deadline-moved:<instant>`; the new deadline's last-call key `registration:<id>:sign-reminder:<deadline>` when that last call is due or due within the hour; otherwise the window's own ask's key `registration:<id>:confirm-participation` when that ask is owed and was never queued — so the job queues neither after it), none while its own declaration email waits to leave, and none when one left within the hour (§606) and the deadline moved later — a deadline moved earlier is sent whatever left within the hour, unless a recent email's key carried the new instant; and an identical second save moves and sends nothing (2026-10-05, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). The editor's card counts the real rows a save would move or that hold the window's instant, and says nothing once that instant is behind and nothing would move; the banner after the save says how many moved. Verification: unit `registrations/window-holds.test.ts`, integration `registrations/window-holds.test.ts`, e2e `window-holds.spec.ts`.

Given a `PENDING_DECLARATION` registration whose hold ends at its event's participation-window deadline, and that deadline is before the start, when the maintenance job runs from the club's `lastCallHours` before that deadline until the deadline, then one `COMPLETE_DECLARATION` is queued with the key `registration:<id>:sign-reminder:<deadline>` — again only if the deadline moves — none when `lastCallHours` is 0 or the instant is at or before the window's opening, and none at the reminder's lead before the start; every other registration keeps the last call at the reminder's lead before the start under `registration:<id>:sign-reminder`; the forecast on «Emailuri» and the job's next wake read the same formula (2026-10-05, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `notifications/last-call-window.test.ts`, integration `registrations/window-holds.test.ts`, `notifications/forecast.test.ts`.

The club's «Termene» setting also holds `lastCallHours`, the hours before a participation window's deadline the last call to sign goes: 0 to 168, 48 by default, 0 = none before the deadline; the «Termene» page shows it with its help in both languages, and «Emailuri» states it in the description of the declaration email (2026-10-05, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `deadlines/deadlines.test.ts`.

batchLine: a changed confirmation window moves the places it reserved, and the last call to sign comes before its deadline
